about: SEARCH (12.11.2026): dictionaries of the site search of blokvolt.com (scripts/world_search.py, static/com/world-search.js). sections: words that lead to a section, in all 30 languages (any language finds a section on every page); stop: connector words dropped from a query ("charging stations in", "Ladestationen", "зарядки в") unless nothing else is left; fast / ultra / ac: words that turn a place into the map with a power filter (single words only); country_alias / network_alias / region_alias: other names; network_merge: networks of the manifest that are one network for a driver (one result, the map with both slugs). Words are folded at build time (case, accents, Cyrillic and Greek do not matter).
